## SYS 05: Proposal & Contract Delivery

**Trigger:** Webhook POST at `/hubspot-deal-proposal-stage` (deal moves to proposal stage).

**What it does:** Pulls deal data from the webhook, uses Claude to generate a tailored consulting proposal (HTML), converts it to PDF via Call PDF Service (html2pdf.fly.dev), uploads to the client's Drive folder, appends a row to the Proposals sheet, and sends the client an email with the link. All content uses CONFIG tiers and branding.

**Dependencies:** CONFIG (id in Get Config), Claude API (inline), PDF via Call PDF Service (inline), SW: Send Email via Resend (id set), SW: Send Google Chat Alert, SW: Log to Automations Log Sheet. After import, select the subworkflows in each remaining Execute Workflow node if they show unset.
